Thanks again for the warm onboarding call this morning. Attaching the completed vendor onboarding form and our W-9 for your records (see attachment stubs). A couple of notes on billing: our standard payment term is Net 45, but to help us cover ramp costs for the initial integration we wanted to request early remit for the first two invoices (up to 30 days) in exchange for a 2% prompt-pay discount.

- Invoice 1: milestone delivery (50%) — pay within 30 days for 2% discount
- Invoice 2: production cutover (25%) — pay within 30 days for 2% discount
- Remaining invoices: Net 45 as standard

We can accept a PO with a note indicating staged invoice acceptance and the early-remit discount for the first two invoices. If you need any legal paperwork, happy to sign an amendment.

Thanks — reviewed the attachments. AP can process the vendor record once Procurement confirms PO language. Two quick notes from finance ops:

1) We can honor early remit for the first two invoices if the PO contains an explicit milestone table and a special payment term line ("First two invoices: pay within 30 days for 2% discount"). AP will need the invoice numbers to match the milestone labels on the PO.

If Dylan confirms Procurement can add the milestone schedule to the PO, I’ll ask AP to prioritize payment on receipt. Otherwise, standard Net 45 will apply.
